The Final CLOUD Airdrop Post
FP
July 16, 2024
The Drop
The CLOUD token mint address is
CLoUDKc4Ane7HeQcPpE3YHnznRxhMimJ4MyaUqyHFzAu
.
You can check your airdrop allocation on
https://lfg.jup.ag/sanctum
.
You can claim your airdrop on the 18th of July, 11am EST.
10% of CLOUD tokens are distributed for the launch airdrop.
5% (50M CLOUD) was given out for
Capital.
5% (50M CLOUD) was given out for
Earnestness.
108,185
Profiles (not wallets)
were eligible for the airdrop.
Capital
The Capital allocation was distributed in direct proportion to your share of the total Wonderland Season 1 EXP. Each Referral Cupcake also gives a 20,000 bonus EXP added to your final Wonderland EXP count. To qualify for this drop, you needed to have signed up for Wonderland and have earned more than 266k EXP.
314,367 wallets signed up for Wonderland. After adjustment to accurately reflect retroactive EXP, the total EXP across all wallets was
2,525,753,364,296.272 -- 2.5 trillion.
The top wallet earned over 100 billion points. This is roughly equivalent to holding 1.7M SOL (~250M USDC) from the start of Wonderland to the end.
Our efforts with Allium Labs allowed us to flag out and blacklist 61181 wallets, about 20% of the total.
Earnestness
To judge Earnestness, the team manually went through millions of posts across Telegram, Discord, Twitter, websites and Youtube, with the cutoff being 1st July 2024 EST 0000.
These are the final distributions:
We have also identified and reserved CLOUD tokens for earnest users who did not set up a Sanctum Profile in time. We will be issuing instructions after the token launch on how to retroactively claim these tokens, or make a claim that we missed you in the original allocation.
Dynamic Airdrop
You have a choice to make with the airdrop.
Long-Term-Aligned: You can wait to claim your airdrop. The longer you wait, the more $CLOUD you get, maxing out at a 100% bonus if you wait the full duration.
Sanctum-Curious: You can claim your airdrop at any time, giving up the bonuses but getting $CLOUD right away.
Your airdrop has two different components, Capital and Earnestness.
To get the full 100% bonus for Capital, wait 14 days;
To get the full 100% bonus for Earnestness, wait 180 days.
You can claim at any time, but you forfeit the rest of the bonus. For example, claiming the Earnestness component after 90 days will give you a 50% bonus.
Again, two options:
Sell your airdrop right away.
Wait to get extra $CLOUD.
All forfeited tokens will go back to the Community Reserve for future airdrops and community initiatives.
Disclaimer
We strongly advise our community members to exercise caution and be wary of potential scams.
